label: For "Predictive Customer Service Agent": Spot customers whose service is degrading, work out the cause from network and account data and act first with a fix, a credit or a message, so many problems are resolved before the customer contacts care. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Counting avoided calls without a control.
